anachronism: A- + chronos: out of time. A knight with a phone.
apothegm: Apo + phthengesthai: speak out. A pithy apothegm.
appurtenant: Ad + pertinere: pertain to. Rights appurtenant to land.
artifice: Ars + facere: made by art. Win by artifice.
atavism: Atavus: ancestor. An atavism from the cave.
besotted: Be + sot: fool. Besotted with her.
bristle: Bristle: stiff hair. Bristle at the insult.
broadside: Ship’s broad side. A broadside in print.
brook: Old English brucan: use. Brook no delay.
chagrin: Chagrin: rough leather rubbing. His chagrin at losing.
chimera: Chimera: fire-breathing monster. Chasing a chimera.
debonair: De bon aire: of good air. A debonair host.
deign: Dignari: think worthy. She didn’t deign to reply.
disingenuous: Dis + ingenuous: not frank. A disingenuous reply.
effervescent: Ex + fervere: boil up. Effervescent laughter.
epigram: Epi + gramma: inscription. A neat epigram.
exemplar: Exemplum: sample. An exemplar of virtue.
gambit: Chess opening sacrifice. A bold gambit.
inanity: Inanis: empty. The inanity of chat.
ineffable: In + effari: not utter. Ineffable joy.
languish: Languere: be weak. Languish in jail.
nettlesome: Nettle: stinging plant. A nettlesome issue.
objurgate: Ob + jurgare: scold. Objurgate the boy.
paragon: Para + akone: touchstone. A paragon of virtue.
percipient: Per + capere: grasp fully. A percipient critic.
philistine: Biblical foes of Israel. A philistine ignores art.
phlegmatic: Phlegm humour: sluggish. A phlegmatic response.
pith: Pith: plant core. The pith of the matter.
rapprochement: Re + approcher: bring near. A rapprochement of rivals.
recrudesce: Re + crudus: raw again. Fever recrudesces.
reprisal: Reprendre: take back. A reprisal attack.
solicitude: Sollicitus: anxious. Solicitude for the sick.
squelch: Squelch: mud sound. Squelch the rumour.
truculence: Trux: fierce. His truculence at meetings.
vitriol: Vitreolus: glassy; sulphuric acid. Spit vitriol.
